ideas.pitch: A voice-first autonomous agent pipeline that listens to rural citizens calling via regular telephony in local dialects, files official grievances into public service delivery databases, and generates cryptographic tracking proofs.
ideas.title: AshaVoice: Multilingual Gram Panchayat Grievance Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Agentic AI For Billions track by solving public service delivery at scale with a voice-first interface, tapping into the public accountability angle seen in winning projects like onrecord.

ideas.pitch: A localized web-scraping and computer vision agent pipeline that monitors regional mandi pricing anomalies alongside early-stage blight detection from low-res WhatsApp photos, sending synthesized SMS advisories to farmers.
ideas.title: KisanGuard: Autonomous Multi-Agent Crop Disease and Market Arbitrage Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering multi-agent pipelines with agricultural impact, explicitly aligning with the agricultural use-case examples highlighted in the hackathon's Agentic AI track.

ideas.pitch: An edge-optimized mobile web app that instantly reads complex multilingual bus schedules, handwritten signboards, and public notices aloud using local OCR models without requiring continuous high-speed internet.
ideas.title: SahayakScan: Offline-First Assistive OCR and Text-to-Speech for Visually Impaired Public Transit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses accessibility and assistive technology directly within the main impact criteria, standing out with a working, highly localized mobile-first demo.

ideas.pitch: A localized transparency dashboard that tracks micro-allocation of public welfare funds down to district levels, attaching cryptographic audit seals to every milestone reported by community workers.
ideas.title: NyayaLedger: Verifiable Public Scheme Fund Tracking
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of combining public accountability transparency with immutable record-keeping, targeting public institution use-cases.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous credit-scoring workflow that aggregates alternative transactional data—such as utility bill consistency and digital ledger entries—to generate fair, explainable loan approvals for street vendors.
ideas.title: VittiyaAI: Explainable Micro-Credit Risk Scoring Agent for Informal Vendors
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the financial inclusion track focus while utilizing explainable AI architecture similar to successful AML and forecasting hackathon winners.
